tasks.name: Protect Main Branch
args:
branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD); if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then echo -e '
\033[1;31m[COMMIT ERROR]\033[0m
Direct commits to main are blocked.
Use: git switch -c <branch-name>
'; exit 1; fi

tasks.name: Validate Commit Message Prefix
args:
commit_msg=$(cat "$1"); pattern='^[^:]+:[[:space:]]+.+$'; if ! echo "$commit_msg" | grep -Eq "$pattern"; then echo -e '
\033[1;31m[INVALID COMMIT MESSAGE]\033[0m
Message must include a prefix followed by a colon and a space.
Example: "project-123: fix bug"
'; exit 1; fi
